summary.zh: 修复桌面版更新提示卡：鼠标从图标移向卡片时不再消失，可以正常悬停阅读更新说明。
summary.en: Desktop update hover card fix: moving the pointer from the titlebar icon into the card no longer dismisses it — release notes are readable again.

highlights.zh: 更新提示卡增加 350ms 关闭宽限期，并在图标与卡片之间补上隐形桥接区域：鼠标移向卡片途中不再触发立即关闭。
highlights.en: The update card gains a 350ms close grace period plus an invisible bridge over the icon-to-card gap, so the pointer path no longer triggers an instant dismiss.

highlights.zh: 键盘操作行为保持不变：Esc 立即关闭，焦点离开即收起。
highlights.en: Keyboard behavior is unchanged: Escape closes immediately and focus loss still collapses the card.

highlights.zh: 本次为前端交互修复，无其他功能变更。
highlights.en: This is a frontend interaction fix only; no other functional changes.
